system_prompt_style.note: Repo contains only README 'Coming soon.'; no prompt code. Paper says the evolved surface includes prompt and task framing, but it does not describe how the prompt is built.

env_context_strategy.note: No code or tool registry is available. The paper mentions shell-based snapshot inspection for ITBench only.

context_compaction.note: Paper lists 'context management' as editable surface without mechanism; no code.

observation_format.note: No observation conversion code in repo.

tool_call_format.note: No parser code; repo is a placeholder.

edit_primitive.note: No edit tool definitions. The optimizer applies git-diff candidate patches, but that is the outer loop, not an agent edit primitive.

tool_schema_source.note: No schema code. The paper mentions MCP providers and schema narrowing.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: The evolved harness can include prompt and task framing, tool interfaces, skills, MCP-backed providers, subagent structure, and agent-loop configuration.
protocol_standardization.note: Paper-only statement; the MCP backend is used for EnterpriseOps-Gym (Sec. 4.1). No code is available to confirm the client.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Following the autoresearch pattern (Karpathy, 2026), the evolution loop measures a baseline, proposes one bounded intervention, evaluates it, retains only an improvement, and repeats from the resulting frontier.
loop_primitives.note: Outer optimizer loop: hill climbing (generate-evaluate-keep) and tree search (Sec. 3.3). The inner Stirrup agent is presumably turn-based react (turns per task, Sec. 5.1). Paper only; no code.

planning_granularity.note: The optimizer's ledger stores hypotheses, but no agent plan object is described.

multi_agent_topology.note: The paper mentions subagent structure as an editable surface, but the default topology is not stated. The system has a proposer (optimizer) plus an agent under test.

short_term_state.note: No state object code is available.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: A persistent memory ledger links patch, session, and evaluation artifacts and carries frontier scores, per-task outcomes, accepted hypotheses, and discarded attempts into later iterations.
long_term_memory.note: The ledger is optimizer-level memory across iterations; the storage form is unspecified, and file_notes is the closest value. Skills are part of the evolved surface (Abstract).

self_verification.evidence_quote: The validator checks scope, imports, and a single-task smoke test. The evaluator runs valid candidates on the hidden selection set when one exists
self_verification.note: This is optimizer-level verification of candidate patches. Agent-level verification is only listed as an editable surface.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Input:benchmarkD; fixed modelM; seed harnessh 0; proposerP; budgetB
retry_policy.note: The optimizer iterates up to budget B candidate patches, which is the closest fit; this is not agent task retry.

rollback.evidence_quote: Each candidate is a git diff against the current frontier
rollback.note: The optimizer reverts rejected candidates to the prior frontier ('It reverts rejected, invalid, and crashed candidates to the prior frontier', Sec. 3.1).

termination_condition.note: The agent-level termination conditions are not described. The paper mentions 'finish logic' as an editable surface only.

execution_isolation.note: The paper mentions a 'sandboxed code-execution environment' for ITBench but gives no general default.

tracing.evidence_quote: For tree search, the ledger is a solution journal containing candidate nodes, parent links, scores, failure states, and promotion decisions.
tracing.note: Paper only; the evolution uses per-task traces.

eval_hooks.note: The paper describes a built-in evaluator in the evolution loop, but the repo is empty, so the pinned repo contents cannot be checked.

guardrails.note: The Sec. 3.4 guardrails constrain optimizer patches, not agent actions.

target_domain.evidence_quote: StarHarness therefore offers a practical way to reduce persistent model–environment mismatch in tool-rich enterprise tasks.
target_domain.note: The target is enterprise SRE/ITSM/finance workflows, which map to other; the harness is a harness-evolution framework.

open_source.note: The repo contains only 'Coming soon.' and no LICENSE file.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: These gains persist on tasks excluded from evolution and transfer without re-evolution across GPT and Qwen model families.
model_agnostic.note: Inferred from multi-vendor evaluation; no client abstraction is visible.

primary_artifact.note: The repo is a placeholder, so coding is from the paper.

first_release_date.note: No tag is available, so the paper v1 date is used per the fallback order.

pinned_version.note: No tagged release; the short hash only comes from the evidence header.

stars.note: Taken from the evidence bundle header; not re-queried.
